ios.desc:
Turn any blank space into your dream room in seconds with AI Interior Designer: Roomify. Our powerful AI analyzes your photos and generates realistic 3D room layouts, furniture suggestions, and décor ideas—no design skills needed.

• Snap a photo of your space—Roomify’s AI Interior Designer identifies walls, windows, and doorways.
• Instantly preview multiple layout options with accurate dimensions.
• Customize with furniture, color palettes, and décor styles from our curated library.
• Save favorite designs to your personal gallery and share mock-ups with friends.
• Export floor plans and shopping lists for easy purchasing.

AI Interior Designer: Roomify makes home makeovers effortless. Whether you’re redecorating a bedroom, planning a new office, or just exploring styles, AI Interior Designer: Roomify brings professional-grade design to your fingertips.
